stem:
Nidhi records tilapia fish, water plants, snails, pond water, dissolved minerals, and sunlight in one pond, and how they interact.

Which claim about this full set is correct?

options.text: The full set is an ecosystem because it includes interacting living and non-living components.
The full set is only a population because fish are present.
The full set is only a community because non-living parts do not count.
The full set is a population because more than one kind of organism is listed.

teacher.key_rationale: An ecosystem includes interacting biotic and abiotic components. A population is one kind of organism; a community omits the abiotic parts.
